**Finding submitted — T4C: deviation.**

- **What the document does:** The Agreement runs until the last Receivable is paid in full (Section 8.3, p0363) — a multi-year term. Our only exit against the Servicer is the for-cause removal in Section 7.2(c) (p0327), exercisable by the Indenture Trustee on a continuing Servicer Termination Event. Sections 8.1/8.2 are Class A Certificateholder optional acquisition/redemption mechanics, not a convenience termination right for the Issuer.
- **Direction check:** Section 7.1 "No Resignation" (p0314) is favourable to us and satisfies the preferred Vendor-side element, so I did not touch it and did not fall back to a position that would let the Servicer exit at term end on 90 days' notice.
- **Cure:** One insertion (new Section 7.7 after p0348) giving the Issuer a 30-day convenience termination with a pro rata refund of prepaid fees — no "in whole or in part" language (no Order Form structure here), and no collateral rewrites needed because Sections 7.3 and 7.4 already operate on any termination "under this Agreement".
